metadata.name: CCBalanceTransfer
metadata.description: This API is used to initiate the balance transfer request to other credit card account associated with different institution.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: PayerAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Payer’s Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: PayerAdminNumber
request_fields.description: Payer’s Admin Number. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:7314145404

request_fields.name: PayeeAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Payee Account Number.(Card No. / Loan Account Number) Valid Values: 0-9 = Card A-Z, 0-9 = Loan Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: RequestedBTAmount
request_fields.description: Amount requested for Balance Transfer. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

request_fields.name: CreditorsName
request_fields.description: Creditor entity Name. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: ABC Corporation Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PayeeAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Payee Address Line 1. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: 123 HWY Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: PayeeAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Payee Address Line 2. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: Park Avenue Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: PayeeAddressLine3
request_fields.description: Payee Address Line 3. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: 330 Primrose St Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: PayeeAddressLine4
request_fields.description: Payee Address Line 4. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: LAKETON RD Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: PayeePostalCode
request_fields.description: Payee Postal Code. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:73141 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: PayeeCity
request_fields.description: City of Payee. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: Los Angeles Allowable Values: 35

request_fields.name: PayeeState
request_fields.description: State of Payee. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section for State Codes Values. Example: AK Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: PayeeCountry
request_fields.description: Country of Payee. Valid Values: Refer appendix section for Country Code Values. Example: US Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: PromotionPlanID
request_fields.description: ID of promotional plan. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Example:abc2123 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: BankRoutingNumber
request_fields.description: Bank Routing number identifies the location of the bank’s branch. Valid Values: 0 -9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:111000038 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: TransferType
request_fields.description: TransferType Of Payee. Valid Values:1,2 Example:CARD = 2,LOAN = 1

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentId
children.description: This is the payment ID which is generated by Bill Payment Services. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 120

children.name: PaymentDate
children.description: This is the date when the payment is expected to be Posted posted to Payee. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

children.name: TransferredAmount
children.description: Initiated Balance Transfer Amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

children.name: TransactionFee
children.description: Transaction Fee Amount ($). Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 10.00

children.name: TotalTransactionAmount
children.description: Sum of requested BT amount and Transaction Fees. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 510.00
